answer: Picture trust as a thread spun outward from a few audited seed agents: each epoch, reputation flows only along edges where agents actually settled paid work with each other, and it decays with every hop. A sybil swarm can mint a thousand identities, but they all dock at the same wharf, joined to honest agents by a handful of costly real trades. Those few attack edges throttle the trust that leaks in, so the fake cluster stays starved however large it grows, and the honest core remains a haven.
